readEffectiveStreamHead(db, branches, stream): the journal head on the effective branch (branchId, revision, digest); an absent effective branch answers the uninstalled genesis identity root/0/genesis-digest (read-only here)
readJournalHead -> readEffectiveStreamHead: the correction lease seam this unit reads through (read-only here)

U19b: a stream's first append installs its genesis branch and effective head in the append's transaction, so a journal stream appended since then always has an effective head (read-only here)

launch-authority caller: no-authoritative-stream -> 200 ungated; a head -> progression gate + validateExpectedBranchHead (outside the path; unchanged). An exception from the resolver lands in its catch -> 500.

out-of-path row 'answers revision 0 for a branch with nothing appended to it': deletes the stream's event_journal_stream_heads rows (events stay) and expects kind 'head' at revision 0. Constrains the existence read: it must be the journal's events, not its head rows.

design: Existence is decided by the journal, not by the branch record: a new port hasJournalStream(stream) answers whether event_journal_events holds any committed event for (stream_type, stream_id). Events are immutable, so this is the durable fact 'the campaign has a journal stream'. False -> no-authoritative-stream; that is the only path to that answer.

The head is read through the correction lease's seam: the private readJournalRevision copy is removed and a port readEffectiveStreamHead(stream) = readEffectiveStreamHead(db, branches, stream) supplies branchId and revision.

effectiveGeneration comes from the stream's effective head record through requireEffectiveHead. A campaign whose journal holds events but whose effective head is missing (a stream first appended before U19b that migration 23 did not backfill) cannot name the journal's effective head, and answering no-authoritative-stream would launch a journaled campaign ungated (CO3 F1). requireEffectiveHead's own 'no-effective-branch' refusal is therefore raised (fail-closed; the routes map it to 500 and the client reads 'unavailable' and refuses the launch). No new error type.

The header comment replaces the stale premise with the rule: no-authoritative-stream means the campaign has no journal stream; a head exists for every journaled campaign (U19b installs it on the first append); the mission launch is gated whenever a head exists.

Red first on real SQLite, in a new suite beside the module: (a) one append -> the head equals the journal effective head (pinned literals and a direct readEffectiveStreamHead read); (b) no journal stream -> no-authoritative-stream; (c) second append -> revision advances and the first head is refused STALE_REVISION by validateExpectedBranchHead (the launch comparison); (d) events present, effective head row dropped -> refused, never no-authoritative-stream. Expected on the baseline: (a)(b)(c) green because U19b installs the effective head, (d) red.

risksForTheParent: Review class authority: this changes what GET /api/campaigns/:id/head and POST /launch-authority answer; the owner's head-bound Lane B ruling on the head semantics is required (OD-launch-head-gate was answered by the parent under OD-mvp-hard-cutover; the ruling binds it to a head).

Behaviour change for a journaled campaign with no effective head (only a stream appended before U19b and never backfilled): it answered no-authoritative-stream (ungated launch); it now raises no-effective-branch (500; the launch is refused as 'unavailable'). Fail-closed by design; under OD-mvp-hard-cutover no pre-cutover data is protected. A local dev database holding such a campaign would see its launch refused until its stream is backfilled.

Every journaled campaign now gets a head, so its launch is gated (progression gate + expected-head comparison) where a pre-U19b build let it through ungated; the parent main proof should include the launch and co-op journeys that exercise it.
